items.q: Is a digital daily receipts book mandatory?
items.a: Yes, for Belgian hospitality businesses not using a certified POS system, a manual or digital daily receipts book is mandatory. Dagontvangst automates the required formatting.

items.q: How does a FOD audit work?
items.a: The inspector requests an export of closures for a given period. With Dagontvangst you download a JSON or PDF bundle with the hash manifest, the proof of integrity that the FOD accepts.

items.q: What if I made a mistake?
items.a: Corrections are append-only: the original stays intact and a new corrective closure is added to the chain referencing the original. This meets the immutability requirement.

items.q: Does it work with multiple businesses?
items.a: Yes. One account supports multiple locations. Each with their own sealed chain, roles, and analytics.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: How we process personal data under the GDPR and the Belgian data protection framework.

sections.b: Dagontvangst BV is the controller of your personal data. Contact: info@dagontvangst.be.

• Account data: name, email address, password (hashed), language preference.
• Business data: trade name, VAT number, address of your location(s).
• Usage data: created daily closures, VAT splits, hash manifest, timestamps, in-app actions.
• Payment data: handled by our payment provider, we only receive billing metadata, never card details.
• Technical data: IP address, browser type, session tokens (essential for security).

• Contract performance (art. 6.1.b GDPR): managing your account, storing your daily receipts book and generating FOD-compliant exports.
• Legal obligation (art. 6.1.c GDPR): tax retention (7 years) and Belgian accounting regulations.
• Legitimate interest (art. 6.1.f GDPR): fraud prevention, service security, feature improvement.
• Consent (art. 6.1.a GDPR): where legally required, e.g. for non-essential communications.

Accounting data (closures, VAT lines, hash chain): 7 years after the close of the fiscal year, per Belgian tax law.
Account data: as long as your account is active, and up to 12 months after cancellation for administrative wrap-up.
Logs and technical data: maximum 12 months.

If your daily closure is still open as midnight approaches, we send a reminder to your account's email address. You choose how far in advance, or switch reminders off entirely, in Settings.
For this we store your preferred lead times and, per reminder sent, a record of the location, date and time, so that you are not notified repeatedly for the same day. These records are deleted after 12 months.
Only owners and managers receive these emails, since only they can seal a day.

sections.h: Data held on your own device
sections.b:
The app keeps some things locally in your browser: a draft of the closure you are working on, your language and theme preference, and, if you are briefly offline, a closure still waiting to be sealed.
This data stays on your device until it is sent or cleared and is not shared with third parties. You can remove it by clearing the site data in your browser.

• Hosting: EU-based cloud provider (data stays within the EEA).
• Payment provider: for subscription handling.
• Accountant: only if you explicitly grant access.
• Authorities: on legally motivated request (e.g. FOD Finance).
We never sell your data to third parties.
We process your data within the EEA. Any exceptional transfer to a third country will only occur based on an adequacy decision or standard contractual clauses.

We apply technical and organisational measures: TLS encryption, password hashing, role-based access control, cryptographic hash chain of closures, and regular backups. Incidents are reported to the Belgian DPA within 72 hours where required.

You have the right at any time to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to or port your data. Contact us at info@dagontvangst.be. You can also file a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (Rue de la Presse 35, 1000 Brussels, dataprotectionauthority.be).

We only use functional and essential cookies (session, language preference, CSRF token). No tracking or advertising cookies. No third-party analytics are loaded on the landing page without your consent.
We may update this privacy policy. The current version is always available at dagontvangst.be/privacy with the date of last update.

The agreement is entered into for an indefinite term and can be cancelled monthly with one month's notice, taking effect at the end of the current month. Upon cancellation, your data remains available for export for 12 months.

Except in cases of wilful misconduct or gross negligence, our liability is limited to the amount of subscription fees paid in the 12 months preceding the incident. We are not liable for indirect damages, loss of revenue or tax penalties resulting from incorrect input by the customer.
We aim for 99.5% uptime on a monthly basis. We are not liable for interruptions caused by force majeure, including outages at hosting partners, legislative changes or other external causes.

All data you enter remains your property. You can download an export in JSON, CSV or PDF at any time, including the hash manifest of the chain.
We may amend these terms. Material changes will be announced at least 30 days in advance. Continued use constitutes acceptance.

This agreement is governed exclusively by Belgian law. Any disputes fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the judicial district of Ghent, Ghent division, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protection rules.
